༄༅/ /klu gtor gdengs can 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// klu gtor gdengs can 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs//

oṃ swasti/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter mnga' ba// 'jig rten mgon la gus btud nas// gdengs can 'dod 'jo bdud rtsi'i gter// gtor ma'i cho ga mdo tsam spel// de la sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham dang*/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ klu gnas pa'i gzhi sogs gtsang ma'i sar maṇ+ḍal dkar po'i khar me tog tshom bu dgu bkod/ de'i mdun du rin po che'i snod du klu sman dang dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i zan ril lam bshos zlum/ 'bru dang rin po che dang dar zab sogs rdzas bye brag pa rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ klu sman 'o ma dang chu gtsang gis bran pa'i bum pa rnams bsham/ bsdu na maṇ+ḍal sogs med par klu sman sbyar ba'i ril bu dang 'o ma'i chab tsam la brten pas rung zhing*/ sgrub pa po yo byad dang bcas pa gtsang zhing dag pas las la 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi cho ga ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bsgom pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā:swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar gsal zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag

/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rang la bstim/ slar yang snying gar zla ba la hrīḥyig dkar po yi ge drug gis bskor ba'i 'od zer spro bsdu dang sbyar te ma ṇi brgya rtsa sogs bzlas nas sngar bzhin mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// zhes sogs kyis bstod nas lha'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o// de nas mchod rdzas rnams rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi rgyas oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes dang rdo rje me'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ mchod rdzas rnams stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin/ byed las klu'i nad rnams zhi zhing dbang po drug la bde ba'i dpal du 'char ba'i bdud rtsi mi 'dzad bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i rgyas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/ mdun gyi rten rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i brag ri bya skyibs can mkha' lding gi gnod pas mi brdzi ba'i mdun du mtsho dang rdzing bu dang ne'u gsing dang skyed mos tshal la sogs pas bskor ba'i pho brang yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar klu rgyal ba ru ṇa dkar po/ shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du nor rgyas ljang gu /mer dung skyong dkar po/ srin por stobs rgyu ljang gu /rlung du rigs ldan sngon po/ dbang ldan du pad chen ser po ste thams cad kyang stod lha'i lus can mdzes 'dzum sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sku smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/ klu rigs grangs med pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ lcags kyu'i rgya bcings te/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis ba ru ṇa dang klu chen brgyad sogs klu dang sa bdag thams cad spyan drangs par bsam la/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ oṃ/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyis rgyu// pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu luṇ+ḍa// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnams dang ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhur+bhu wa phruṃ phu swā hā/ zhes mdun du byon par bsam la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ yid 'ong dgyes pa'i zhing khams su/ pad+ma'i gdan la zhi ba dang*// dge ba'i thugs kyis bzhugs nas kyang*// bdag cag re ba skong bar mdzod// ces pas gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor can rnams kyang dgyes shing ngo 'thon du bzhugs pa'i klu rnams kyi mtha' 'od kyis bskor bas gtor ma ma thob kyi bar phyir 'gro sa med par bsam mo// de nas/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛh+ṇi daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ sam+bhā ra dang mtshan bzhi brjod nas mchog sbyin gyi rgya bcas la/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mthil nyid du// a las zla steng hrīḥdakar po// de las sim byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun// babs pas snod khengs phyir lud pa// klu gnyan sa bdag la las 'thung*// 'ga' zhig khrus byed rtse zhing rol// lus nyams sos shing bde dga' yis// tshims shing lha lus thob par gyur// oṃ ba su kī maṃ swā hā/

zhes chu rgyun sbreng bzhin du brgya rtsa sogs bzlas nas/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phu swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha phruṃ phu swā hā/ zhes bdun dang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis sam/ spro na so so'i ming sngags/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ye: oṃ a nan+ta ye: oṃ shaṅkha pā la ye: oṃ pad+ma ye: oṃ karko ṭa ye: oṃ tak+ṣa ka ye: oṃ ku lu ka ye: oṃ ba su kī ye: oṃ ma hā pad+ma ye: zhes pa'i mthar a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul nas/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyis rgyu// pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu luṇ+ḍa// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang*// tshi li chen po rnams dang ni// zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ klu chen 'khor bcas gtor ma bzhes// mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di// mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che// rin chen phreng ba'i them skas can// klu yi gnod pa skyob byed pa// mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// klu las gyur pa'i gnod pa ni// mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /bsam ngan dug nad kha rlangs dug /de la sogs pa'i dug rnams kun// yud tsam gyis ni zhi gyur cig /bdag las gces pa'i rdzas khyer la// bdag la gnod pa ma byed par// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// pha ma lta bu'i sems kyis ltos//

zhes pa'i mthar/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes sogs chos kyi sbyin pa ci rigs bya/ klu rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i ched du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nāñca swā hā/ ci nus bzla/ sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyi/ lus kyi na tsha sos gyur cig /sems kyi sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /yan lag nyams dang nying lag nyams// nyams pa'i lus rnams sos gyur cig /mkha' las bye tshan babs pa dang*// sha khrag bu chung gcer bu'i 'jigs// gnod pa de rnams zhi gyur cig /sdug bsngal nad kyis zin pa la// sman gyi mchog tu 'di gyur cig /'jigs shing skrag pas dngangs pa la// mgon skyabs mchog tu 'di gyur cig /dbul zhing phongs pas mnar ba la// 'dod dgu'i dpal du 'di gyur cig /bkres shing skom pas gdung ba la// bza' btung mchog tu 'di gyur cig /'gro dus lam ngan rnyed pa la// lam mkhan mchog tu 'di gyur cig /ma rig mun pas 'thibs pa la// snang gsal mchog tu 'di gyur cig /gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// 'chi med mchog tu 'di gyur cig /mdor na gang la gang dgos pa// rgyun chad med par 'byung bar shog / ces dang gzhan yang*/ klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams kyi// gnas dang pho brang bshig pa dang*// sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan bsgul// shing gnyan bcad dang brag gnyan gshags// ne'u gsing brus dang chu mig bsubs// nya sbal bsad dang grog tshang bshigs// yan lag bregs dang rwa rmig snad// mi gtsang dri ma phog pa sogs// nyes pa'i skyon gyis khyed rnams la// nad dang sdug bsngal ci mchis pa// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho yi// bdud rtsi'i sman 'dis sos gyur cig

/klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun// sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar// shin tu khros pa zhi gyur cig /dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du// mkho dgu'i longs spyod thams cad dang*// nyams pa'i lus ni sos shing rgyas// yan lag thams cad bde gyur cig /ngan song gsum las thar gyur nas// tshangs pa'i bde dang ldan gyur cig /chos spyod dbang po dul nas kyang*// phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong shog / ces sogs kyis smon lam btab nas 'od kyi ra ba mi dmigs par sbyangs te/ slar yang*/ sngags dang sman sogs byin rlabs kyis// nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas// drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la// rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis// oṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes pas dkar phyogs pa rnams gshegs/ bya khyung gi rgya bcings te/ srid pa las las grub pa yi// bka' dang dam la ma gtogs pa'i// gdug pa can gyi klu rnams kun// rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs// oṃ ga ru ṭa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes nag phyogs pa rnams bskrad nas gtor ma gtsang sar 'dor zhing*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig / ces bden stobs brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas smon lam shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes klu gtor gdengs can 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni dge sbyong blo gsal rgya mtshos bskul ngor khungs ldan yig rnying gi dgongs pa bzhin 'gyur med rdo rjes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod blo gros kyi nor ldan rigs kyi bu 'gyur med yid bzhin legs grub kyis bgyis pa'o// //
